The official issuer profile directly supports the stated identity, specialization, exclusivity characterization, leadership characterization, and 1999 founding date. Stopped before the eight-turn limit; no independent ranking or market-denominator evidence was located.
The exclusivity and leadership language is supported by the issuer’s own profile, not by an independent industry census or ranking.
The issuer’s explicit exclusivity scope is microwave/mmWave passive-component design and manufacturing in Taiwan; its profile also describes antennas among its products.
